mapper.sql: id, seckill_goods_id, order_id, user_id, status, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO seckill_order (seckill_goods_id, order_id, user_id, status, created_at, updated_at, create_by, update_by) VALUES (#{seckillGoodsId}, #{orderId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy})
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM seckill_order WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM seckill_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND seckill_goods_id = #{seckillGoodsId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM seckill_order WHERE order_id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT
FROM seckill_order WHERE status = 1 AND created_at < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutMinutes} MINUTE) ORDER BY id ASC
